messages.subject: Winter jacket
messages.text:
Hello Lasclay friends,

I’m thinking of purchasing the ladies winter jacket. The website says it’s made for Canadian winters. I was hoping you could tell me what that translates to in degrees Celsius? Is it suitable for a -15C day? -20C? 

Thanks,

Sharon.

Sent from my iPad

messages.subject: Re: Winter jacket
messages.text:
Hello Sharon,
 

 We tested it last January in temperatures down to -22C, walking for more than an hour quite comfortably. It's a lightweight jacket but milkweed is a very powerful insulation material. Feel free if you have any other question 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay

messages.subject: Re: Winter jacket
messages.text:
Okay, thanks for that feedback. Almost there. 1 more question. As per the measurements I should order a medium but my waist measurement is 1 inch more than the waist scale given. If I go to size large I will have a loose fit which isn’t a big deal for me, but, it usually means the sleeve will be way too long. 
 Could you tell me the length of the sleeve on a size large please? 
 That was my last question before making my decision. ☺️
 
 Thanks,
 Sharon.

messages.subject: Re: Winter jacket
messages.text:
Hello Sharon,
 

 There is a difference of 1/2 inch in the sleeve length between the Medium and Large sizes for the coat. The sleeve length is 25 inches for the Medium and 25.5 inches for the Large. You can measure the length of your arm to see which one would suit you best.
 

 Kind regards,
 ___
 

 Catherine 
 

 Lasclay
